name: Phenprobamate
summary: Phenprobamate (Gamaquil, Isotonil, Actozine) is a centrally acting skeletal muscle relaxant, with additional sedative and anticonvulsant effects. Its mechanism of action is probably similar to meprobamate. Phenprobamate has been used in humans as an anxiolytic, and is still sometimes used in general anesthesia and for treating muscle cramps and spasticity.

pharmacology.text: Its mechanism of action is probably similar to meprobamate.

uses.text: Phenprobamate has been used in humans as an anxiolytic, and is still sometimes used in general anesthesia and for treating muscle cramps and spasticity. Phenprobamate is still used and available OTC in some European countries, but it has generally been replaced by newer drugs. It has been sold labeled as a nootropic.

summaryZh: 苯丙氨酯（英語：Phenprobamate）是一種作用於中樞的骨骼肌鬆弛劑，具有額外的鎮靜和抗痙攣作用。過量使用類似於巴比妥類藥物。其作用機制可能與甲丙氨酯相似。苯丙氨酯已作為抗焦慮藥用於人類，有時仍用做全身麻醉和治療肌肉抽筋和痙攣。苯丙氨酯仍在一些歐洲國家使用，但已普遍被更新的藥物所取代。
summaryZhHans: 苯丙氨酯（英语：Phenprobamate）是一种作用于中枢的骨骼肌松弛剂，具有额外的镇静和抗惊厥作用。过量使用类似于巴比妥类药物。其作用机制可能与甲丙氨酯相似。苯丙氨酯已作为抗焦虑药用于人类，有时仍用做全身麻醉和治疗肌肉抽筋和痉挛。苯丙氨酯仍在一些欧洲国家使用，但已普遍被更新的药物所取代。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, dizziness and poor coordination. Carbamates of this kind can cause dependence, and withdrawal after heavy use can include seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、頭暈與協調變差。這類胺甲酸酯可能造成依賴，大量使用後戒斷時可能出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、头晕与协调制差。这类胺甲酸酯可能造成依赖，大量使用后戒断时可能出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is a carbamate, closely related to meprobamate, the tranquilliser that was the most prescribed drug in the United States in the late 1950s.
fact.zh: 它屬於胺甲酸酯類，與甲丙胺酯關係密切；後者是 1950 年代末美國處方量最大的鎮靜劑。
fact.zhHans: 它属于胺甲酸酯类，与甲丙胺酯关系密切；后者是 1950 年代末美国处方量最大的镇静剂。
